purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for DWH policy bindings, record-scope filters, field masking/redaction, derived-result propagation and governance-decision evidence.

topics.name: DWH Governance Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for DWH policy bindings, record-scope filters, field masking/redaction, derived-result propagation and governance-decision evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Policy, binding, resource, field, governance evaluation and AccessCore decision identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing policy/effective access grants no data or policy-edit authority.
semantics.action_rule: edit-policy/rebind/test-evaluate/reclassify/declassify operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.derived_rule: Effective visibility is displayed as a derived result over exact DWH+AccessCore inputs.
semantics.graph_rule: Policy→scope→decision edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.redaction_rule: Monitor never reveals values hidden by the evaluated policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Ambiguous policy, unknown result, policy conflict and AC-vs-DWH denial are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: DWH governance may restrict or project data according to exact schema/classification/scope policy but never creates AccessCore rights, semantic ownership or broader visibility than the underlying authorized source set.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates DWH and AccessCore policy

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for DWH policy bindings, record-scope filters, field masking/redaction, derived-result propagation and governance-decision evidence.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH access governance, schema resolution, classification and AccessCore contracts.
